draft_payload_json.title: Cardiovascular/cerebrovascular outcome cohort
draft_payload_json.description: First occurrence of myocardial infarction, heart failure, stroke, or cardiovascular death following index.
draft_payload_json.entry_event: First qualifying CV/cerebrovascular diagnosis or death

draft_payload_json.title: Age- and gender-matched non-hypertensive controls
draft_payload_json.description: Adults >18 years without recorded hypertension diagnosis or elevated BP readings, matched on age and gender to the hypertensive cohort.
draft_payload_json.entry_event: Index date matched to HTN cohort entry
draft_payload_json.exit_strategy: HTN diagnosis, end of observation, or death

draft_payload_json.title: Renal sympathetic denervation recipients
draft_payload_json.description: Patients undergoing renal nerve ablation procedures for hypertension.
draft_payload_json.exit_strategy: End of follow-up, with BP recorded at 1, 3, 6, and 12 months post-procedure

draft_payload_json.title: Treatment-resistant hypertension
draft_payload_json.description: Treated hypertensive patients with persistently elevated BP despite use of 3 or more antihypertensive agents.
draft_payload_json.entry_event: Concurrent prescription of ≥3 antihypertensive drug classes with persistently elevated BP
draft_payload_json.exit_strategy: BP control achieved, end of observation, or death

draft_payload_json.title: Elevated BP without HTN diagnosis
draft_payload_json.description: Patients with two consecutive recordings SBP >130 or DBP >80 (Stage 1+ HTN by readings) prior to any HTN diagnosis entry.
draft_payload_json.exit_strategy: Recorded HTN diagnosis, end of observation, or death

draft_payload_json.title: Adults with ≥2 recorded BPs (denominator for prevalence)
draft_payload_json.description: All patients >18 years of age with a minimum of 2 recorded blood pressures within the preceding 2 years.
draft_payload_json.entry_event: Second recorded BP measurement within 2-year window

draft_payload_json.title: New-onset hypertension cohort (study group)
draft_payload_json.description: Adults >18 years with newly recorded hypertension diagnosis per US guidelines (SBP >130 or DBP >80 on two consecutive measurements), no prior cardiovascular or cerebrovascular disease, no abnormal kidney function, no thyroid disease, and no prior antihypertensive medication use.
draft_payload_json.entry_event: First recorded HTN diagnosis preceded by ≥2 consecutive BP measurements with SBP >130 or DBP >80 within prior 2 years
draft_payload_json.exit_strategy: End of continuous observation, death, or end of study follow-up

draft_payload_json.title: Cardiovascular and cerebrovascular outcomes after HTN diagnosis: delayed vs timely diagnosis
draft_payload_json.policy: Protocol-derived analysis plans compile into native Parthenon analysis records after feasibility, verification, and review.

blockers.message: Run source feasibility before materializing this protocol-derived analysis plan.

warnings.message: Protocol-derived analysis settings require Study Designer review before execution.

draft_payload_json.rationale: Secondary goal explicitly seeks to reproduce Lu et al findings on diagnostic delay and cardiovascular outcomes, with the addition of a non-hypertensive matched control comparison.
draft_payload_json.description: Compare incidence of subsequent cardiovascular events, cerebrovascular events, and mortality between patients with delayed (>1 year) versus timely HTN diagnosis, with comparison to age- and gender-matched non-hypertensive controls (a comparison Lu et al. did not perform).

design_json.estimand: Hazard ratio / risk difference for CV and cerebrovascular outcomes

protocol_fields.comparator: Patients with timely HTN diagnosis and/or age- and gender-matched non-hypertensive controls (for outcomes comparisons).
protocol_fields.time_at_risk: From HTN diagnosis (or index) to event, end of follow-up, or death

draft_payload_json.rationale: Secondary goals include characterizing primary drug selection, treatment delays, and resistant hypertension regimens, and identifying renal denervation candidates.
draft_payload_json.description: Characterize the type and class of primary antihypertensive drug prescribed after diagnosis, length of delay from diagnosis to first prescription, and longitudinal medication sequences. Identify patients with persistent HTN despite 3+ antihypertensive agents and the composition of their regimens (including proportion receiving a diuretic). Identify patients receiving renal denervation procedures.

draft_payload_json.rationale: Secondary goal to reproduce findings of Lu et al on diagnostic delay and characterize prevalence by region/density.
draft_payload_json.description: Estimate prevalence of at least Stage 1 hypertension (two consecutive BP readings SBP>130 or DBP>80) in the overall population, and incidence of recorded HTN diagnosis. Measure the interval between the first/second recorded elevated BPs and the recorded HTN diagnosis. Stratify by urban vs rural / population density.

draft_payload_json.rationale: Principal goal is to describe prevalence, characteristics, primary antihypertensive drug selection, and diagnostic timeliness in a large general HTN cohort.
draft_payload_json.description: Characterize demographics (age, gender, race, region, anthropometrics), serial blood pressures by source of measurement (office, clinic, ABPM), laboratory work-up (CBC, CMP, lipid profile, serum aldosterone), imaging/functional studies (kidney, heart, carotid), antihypertensive medications longitudinally, and follow-up duration in adults with newly diagnosed hypertension and no prior cardiovascular, kidney, thyroid disease, or antihypertensive therapy.

protocol_fields.comparator: Patients with timely HTN diagnosis and/or age- and gender-matched non-hypertensive controls (for outcomes comparisons).
protocol_fields.time_at_risk: From HTN diagnosis to last follow-up or death
